meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: Claude 会先派子代理查文档和代码,汇总允许使用的 API 清单;再产出分阶段计划,每阶段包含实现内容、文档出处、验证清单和禁止事项,最后给出验收步骤。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、任务或多步实现时触发,尤其是准备用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 我要给购物车加优惠券功能,先做个分阶段实施计划。
say.note: Claude 会先查文档再产出计划。

say.text: 把这次登录接口升级拆成阶段计划,每步注明要参考的文档。
say.note: 计划会包含文档出处和验证清单。

say.text: 帮我规划这个多步重构任务,先做文档勘查再列阶段。
say.note: 会先进 Phase 0 文档勘查。

howto.what_en: Claude first sends subagents to read docs/code and consolidates an allowed-APIs list; then produces a phased plan with implementation content, doc references, verification checklist, and anti-pattern guards, ending with acceptance steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: I want to add a coupon feature to the cart; first make a phased implementation plan.
say_en.note: Claude will check docs before producing the plan.

say_en.text: Break this login API upgrade into a phased plan, citing docs for each step.
say_en.note: Plan lists doc references and verification checks.

say_en.text: Plan this multi-step refactor; do documentation discovery first, then phases.
say_en.note: It starts with Phase 0 documentation discovery.
